heading: Field Orders — Eyes Only
lines: If you're reading this, the mission has officially begun.
Somewhere out there, a gift is waiting for you.
It has been chosen with more thought than I've put into most decisions in my life.
But I'm not going to make this easy.
You'll have to earn it — one memory, one song, one riddle at a time.
Every chapter you unlock today is real. We lived all of it.
So take your time. Play properly. Cheat if you want — I would.
No matter how close you get, no matter how sure you are —
the gift reveals itself only when it's ready.
